description:
Job Title: SCRUM MASTER L2
City: Hyderabad
State/Province: Telangana
Posting Start Date: 9/26/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.  

**Role Purpose**

As a trained Scrum Master, you are responsible for facilitating a Scrum team and are accountable for removing impediments of the team to achieve the sprint goals/deliverables. You are responsible to ensure that the Scrum process is used as intended. A key part of your role is to protect the development team, allow the teams to be self managed, foster collaboration across teams and keep them focused on the tasks at hand.


**͏**
-----


**Do**

* Is accountable for meeting Sprint objectives along with scrum team
* Ensure meeting of sprint commitment
* Own and help resolve impediments of the team
* Help PO adopt Scrum Process properly and ensure PO availability
* Support the PO in maintaining the Product Backlog, defining User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate estimation, backlog refinement and all planning ceremonies
* Ensure that DOR, DOD, Acceptance criteria is available and adhered to
* Ensure MoSCoW adherence of Sprint Backlog at the Sprint level
* Accountable for the correct implementation of the Agile Process
* Protect the team from external interference.
* Facilitate technical assistance to the team and enables clear communication amongst the team members
* Participate in Scrum of Scrum across teams and highlights impediments
* Provide feedback on the team members performance to the Agile Line manager and Agile Program Leader
* Facilitate all the Scrum Ceremonies (Planning, Daily Standup, Grooming, Demo, restrospection) and ensure correct adoption
**͏**
-----


* Ensure updating of all Scrum artifacts
* Ensure ALM tool (either client or Wipro) is updated on a daily basis
* Update key Scrum metrics into Wipro internal tool on a Sprint\-by\-Sprint basis
* Analyse key Scrum metrics and take corrective actions
* Create competency improvement and cross\-skilling plan for the team (by the start of the project). Review monthly and ensure improvement in competency score. Ensure multiskilling for at least 50% of the team.
* Help team attain stable velocity within 6\-8 sprints (allowing for 10% variation either way)
* Train team on the proper adoption of Agile processes (Scrum / XP / Kanban)
* Help in adoption of engineering practices like ATDD, TDD, CI, CD, Refactoring
* Record and own the restrospection actions
* Participate in community of practice initiatives
* Provide inputs to the Line manager for internal quality forums (QIC / APR / QBR / MBR etc.)
**͏**
-----


**͏**
-----

  

Mandatory Skills: Agile\-Scrum .  

Experience: 8\-10 Years .  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**Job Description**

**About the Role:**
===================


**Grade Level (for internal use):**


11
**The Role:** Scrum Master


**The Team:** Our Technology Governance \& Delivery Enablement team at S\&P Dow Jones Indices is responsible for establishing effective portfolio planning and execution patterns in order to drive operational excellence and fostering a culture of collaboration through lean portfolio management and enabling agile ways of working. As a member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating our technology delivery leveraging agile and lean principles.


**The Impact:** We are looking for a motivated individual who is ready to take their career to the next level. This person will play a pivotal role in guiding the teams to adopt Agile practices and methodologies starting with mindset shift to deliver prioritized business value. This person will be responsible to facilitate one to two Scrum teams with focus on team dynamics, continuous learning and agile maturity across teams and ART(s). This person will be responsible for removing any impediments to help the teams achieve their iteration/sprint goals and PI objectives. Will work closely with the Product Manager, Product Owner, Tech leads, UI/UX, security, QE leads and other team members to make sure the product/solution/platform development meets the business needs, aligns with product roadmap and prioritization.


**The Career Opportunity:** This role offers immense potential for growth and professional development in a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment. You will enjoy the open, transparent culture and the opportunity to:


* Be part of global teams to deliver innovative solutions to the market
* Further enhance your agile, collaboration and delivery skills with focus on building team’s agility within a large organization
* Build relationships and engage with stakeholders across the organization, managing stakeholder expectations to deliver the best solution
  

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Coach teams on Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and built\-in quality practices.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning; guide the team through draft planning, backlog readiness, blocker identification, dependency coordination, risk resolution, and team objective alignment to broader OKRs in partnership with other Scrum Masters and the RTE.
* Remove impediments, proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and improve team flow using Agile metrics; take accountability for timely escalation and resolution of risks, blockers, and bottlenecks that impact iteration goals and PI objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement, self\-organization, decision\-making, and conflict resolution.
* Create a trusted and safe team environment where team members can openly share inputs, surface concerns, and collaborate constructively while supporting effective decision\-making and conflict resolution.
* Represent the team in Scrum\-of\-Scrums, ART Syncs, Value Stream Syncs, and other cross\-team forums; coordinate with Scrum teams, ARTs, RTEs, Product Owners, Product Managers, and technical leads to communicate dependencies, improve transparency, and ensure delivery alignment.
* Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Technical Leads to maintain a healthy backlog by ensuring MVPs, features, and user stories are clear, concise, prioritized, and aligned to business goals, product roadmap, and team readiness.
* Generate and maintain Agile dashboards and metrics that support data\-driven decisions, transparency, predictability, and continuous improvement; promote adoption of AI/GenAI practices, including the effective balance of digital and human teams, use of AI agents in team ways of working, and application of GenAI across product and development lifecycles.  

  

  

  

**What we are looking for:**
* 12–15\+ years of industry experience, including 5–6 years as a Scrum Master across product teams.
* Experience working in SAFe, value streams, and Agile Release Trains.
* Strong facilitation, conflict resolution, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement skills.
* Ability to understand domain\-specific and technical discussions to facilitate Agile events, dependency conversations, risk reviews, and team decision\-making in a meaningful way.
* Proven ability to improve Agile execution, delivery predictability, quality, and business value.
* Proven track record of enabling teams to deliver prioritized business value efficiently with a focus on accelerated delivery, enhanced quality, measurable outcomes, and maximum ROI.
* Expertise in Agile metrics, Kanban practices, lean portfolio management, and enterprise software delivery lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence, Power BI, MS Teams, SharePoint, JIRA, or VersionOne.
* Excellent organizational, statistical, analytical, problem\-solving, written communication, and oral presentation skills.
* Exposure to AI capabilities in Scrum and SAFe practices.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in finance, business management, information technology, or a related field.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Financial industry experience preferred.
* SAFe Scrum Master 6\.0 certification required; SASM, PSM, CSM, APM, or CTC certifications are a plus.
* Prior Agile Coach experience and familiarity with BDD, ATDD, TDD, CI/CD, pair programming, automation, and Kaizen preferred.
  

  

**Overall Characteristics:**
* Assertive, industry\-aware, and confident in guiding teams on Agile/Scrum principles, SAFe 6\.0, Scrum/Kanban with AI\-enabled practices, and built\-in quality; able to act as a voice of reason and authority, make tough calls, and ensure Agile principles are consistently applied.
* Self\-starter who promotes strategic alignment and is methodical, detail\-oriented, efficient, organized, and highly productive.
* Creates transparency by bringing the right level of disclosure to appropriate forums, stakeholders, and leadership to build trust and support timely decisions.
* Comfortable using AI to improve productivity, decision\-making, and team/product outcomes.

**Grade: 11**

**Shift Time: 12 to 9 pm IST**

**Location: Hyderabad Orion**


**Working Model: twice a week work from office**

title: Specialist Scrum Master - DTI Marketing
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-253824 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 23, 2026 CATEGORY: Engineering
The Specialist Scrum Master serves as a servant leader and Agile coach for one or more Scrum teams. This role is responsible for enabling high\-performing teams through effective facilitation, coaching, impediment removal, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence. The Specialist Scrum Master partners closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Architects, and business stakeholders to maximise value delivery and accelerate Agile maturity.### **Key Responsibilities**


Agile Leadership \& Coaching

* Coach teams on Scrum principles, Agile practices, and servant leadership.
* Foster self\-organisation, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Help teams mature in Agile delivery practices and product thinking.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote psychological safety.


Scrum Facilitation

* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Refinements, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies remain outcome\-driven and focused on value delivery.
* Drive effective backlog refinement and sprint goal alignment.


Impediment Management

* Identify, track, and facilitate removal of team and organisational blockers.
* Escalate risks and dependencies when necessary.
* Enable teams to proactively address impediments rather than creating dependency on the Scrum Master.


Delivery Excellence

* Monitor Sprint health, team velocity, predictability, and flow metrics.
* Support forecasting, release planning, and delivery commitments.
* Drive adoption of Agile metrics to improve performance and predictability


Stakeholder Collaboration

* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog.
* Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to align delivery objectives.
* Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies transparently.


Continuous Improvement

* Lead meaningful retrospectives resulting in actionable improvements.
* Drive process optimisation initiatives across teams.
* Promote Lean and Agile best practices throughout the organisation

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Agile environments.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software delivery teams.
* Deep understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent Agile tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus).
* Knowledge of Agile metrics, flow efficiency, and Lean product delivery

### **Success Measures**

* Improved sprint predictability and delivery reliability.
* Reduced delivery impediments and cycle time.
* Increased team engagement and Agile maturity.
* High stakeholder satisfaction.
* Continuous improvement actions implemented and sustained

title: ADF Senior Technical Specialist
description:
ADF Senior Technical Specialist
Hyderabad, Telangana
**Job Summary**
---------------


Your Role:
  

As the Senior Data Engineer in the Data Foundation scope, you have in\-depth knowledge of the technical details and how the products work, and you will act as an expert in the team responsible for the technical configuration, development and integration of products and platforms based on our tech stack, used by specific business processes across OpCos, to better serve their customers.


You will provide expert guidance and ensure alignment with architecture and business objectives and ensure on\-time delivery. You drive the end\-to\-end operations of the platforms, keeping them streamlined, structured, and within service level agreements.
  

You will collaborate closely with other cross functional teams for efficient development pipelines.


You will work directly with the Product Owner(s) and Product Architect(s), receiving pre\-defined business requirements and translating them into technical specifications and services in line with overall engineering standards and roadmaps.


You will be expected to be implementing new features, deliver high quality code, follow the agile methodologies and be a team player. The most important part is to be part of the team effort towards value\-driven outcomes and the successful completion of tasks. Your proactive approach will be key in maintaining comprehensive documentation and collaborating with your team members through offering help, raising question and actively taking part in all activities.


You will serve as a key contributor in refining and driving excellence in engineering practices to deliver high\-quality solutions throughout the software development lifecycle in our Data landscape.


The role reports directly to the Data Engineering Lead


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

This role also provides an opportunity to **mentor engineers, strengthen team capabilities, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to engineering excellence** within a global aerospace organization.

 **Job Title:**

 **HIH \- Software Engineering Advisor – SAP Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP) Technical Product Owner**

 **Position Overview**

  

The SAP Procure\-to\-Pay Technical Product Owner is accountable for the vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, and measurable value of SAP S/4HANA Procure\-to\-Pay capabilities. This role connects procurement and finance stakeholders with architecture, engineering, integration, data, security, and support teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and user\-centered solutions.

  

**Job Overview:**


The Product Owner translates business outcomes into prioritized epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans; makes timely scope and priority decisions; and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, global process standards, and the broader SAP transformation roadmap. The role retains sufficient functional and technical depth to guide solution design across SAP MM/PTP, EDI/IDoc, EWM, Finance\-to\-Manage, Order\-to\-Cash, Learn\-to\-Order, master data, SAP Fiori, BTP, and external supplier platforms.

 **Responsibilities:**

 **Product Strategy, Roadmap \& Agile Delivery**

  

* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, roadmap, and outcome\-based priorities for SAP S/4HANA PTP capabilities.
* Own and continuously refine the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablers, defects, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and nonfunctional requirements.
* Prioritize work using business value, user impact, risk reduction, regulatory needs, architectural dependencies, operational stability, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Partner with business leaders, product management, architects, engineering teams, Scrum Masters, and delivery partners to establish release objectives and executable plans.
* Lead discovery, requirements workshops, process reviews, solution option analysis, and decomposition of business needs into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily collaboration, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and program increment activities as applicable.
* Provide clear and timely decisions on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and acceptance; validate completed work against agreed acceptance criteria and product outcomes.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment through transparent roadmap, backlog, dependency, risk, release, and value\-delivery reporting.

 **SAP Solution \& Technical Ownership**

  

* Guide end\-to\-end solution design across purchase requisitions, purchase orders, sourcing, contracts, service procurement, inventory movements, Logistics Invoice Verification, three\-way matching, GR/IR, account determination, and supplier master data.
* Ensure product decisions align with SAP S/4HANA standards, enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, reusable integration patterns, security, audit controls, and supportability expectations.
* Partner with solution and technical architects to evaluate configuration, extension, integration, workflow, reporting, data, automation, and custom\-development options.
* Own functional intent and delivery outcomes for interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, APIs, OData services, CDS views, batch jobs, and related WRICEF objects.
* Drive cross\-functional integration with SAP EWM, FTM/FI\-CO, OTC/SD, LTO or eCommerce, master data, analytics, security, quality, external suppliers, logistics providers, and financial institutions.
* Ensure robust EDI, IDoc, API, file, and middleware capabilities, including mapping, routing, monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling, reprocessing, and trading\-partner onboarding.
* Balance new capability delivery with technical debt reduction, reliability, performance, compliance, lifecycle management, and production support needs.

 **User Experience, Release \& Value Management**

  

* Champion intuitive, role\-based SAP Fiori experiences across requisitioning, approvals, purchasing, goods receipt, supplier invoicing, exception management, and procurement analytics.
* Use stakeholder feedback, process data, support trends, and user research to identify pain points and prioritize improvements.
* Define release readiness and acceptance expectations across testing, security, data, integration, controls, training, cutover, communications, deployment, and support transition.
* Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, cutover validation, hypercare, and post\-production stabilization.
* Define product measures and monitor outcomes such as adoption, cycle time, automation, straight\-through processing, supplier acknowledgment, receipt and invoice exceptions, blocked invoices, GR/IR aging, interface reliability, and user satisfaction.
* Inspect delivery results and operational performance, then adjust the roadmap and backlog to improve business value and product health.
* Support training, change management, release communications, user documentation, and adoption plans for global stakeholders.

 **Stakeholder \& Operational Leadership**

* Serve as the primary product decision\-maker and trusted partner for procurement, finance, supply chain, operations, technology, and delivery stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions across competing priorities, clarify tradeoffs, manage expectations, and escalate risks or impediments when necessary.
* Lead production issue prioritization, defect triage, root\-cause follow\-through, service restoration decisions, and continuous\-improvement planning.
* Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, consultants, and managed\-service partners while retaining accountability for product outcomes.
* Promote product thinking, Agile practices, knowledge transfer, transparency, and a culture of ownership across global delivery and support teams.

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 11 or more years of SAP PTP/MM functional configuration and delivery experience, including at least one full SAP S/4HANA implementation.
* Advanced experience with purchasing, source determination, inventory management, Logistics Invoice Verification, three\-way matching, GR/IR, account determination, supplier master data, and procurement controls.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EDI and IDoc design, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, reprocessing, and trading\-partner onboarding in a high\-volume SAP environment.
* Demonstrated experience integrating PTP with SAP EWM, FTM/FI\-CO, OTC/SD, LTO or eCommerce capabilities, master data, and external supplier systems.
* Experience creating functional specifications and leading delivery for interfaces, enhancements, APIs, workflows, reports, forms, and related WRICEF objects.
* Experience configuring, testing, supporting, and driving adoption of SAP Fiori applications, launchpad content, workflows, role\-based access, and embedded analytics.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end testing, defect resolution, cutover, hypercare, production support, and continuous improvement across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and supplier\-facing communication skills.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale distribution, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated and high\-volume industry.
* Experience with SAP Integration Suite/CPI, PI/PO, BTP, APIs, OData services, CDS views, ALE, middleware monitoring, AS2, SFTP, or supplier\-network integrations.
* Knowledge of common procurement and logistics EDI transactions, including purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory activity, remittance, and functional acknowledgments.
* Experience with decentralized or embedded SAP EWM integration, stock transport orders, intercompany procurement, third\-party procurement, drop shipping, returns, and complex warehouse receiving scenarios.
* Experience with SAP Activate, Solution Manager, Cloud ALM, Jira, Confluence, Agile delivery, and global\-template deployment.
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement, Materials Management, Fiori, or a related discipline.

 **Core Competencies**

* Thought leadership, strategic execution, ownership, and supplier\-facing communication.

 **Work Hours:**


Standard work hours are 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST, with flexibility required to support US Eastern Time business hours as needed.

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.
